title: Is social media dead?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What would make you stop using a social-media platform permanently?
Are people posting less because they value privacy more, or because social media has become less interesting?
Do private groups and messaging apps now replace some functions of traditional social media?
Would your life improve if social media disappeared for one month?
What should a new social platform do differently to feel healthier than today's platforms?
